description: Ground-truth manifest defined independently from CCA predictions. Each case describes one controlled graph-level scenario.

cases.name: consistent-layered-project
cases.description: Every observed dependency is declared and respects layer order.

cases.name: layer-skipping
cases.description: Presentation depends directly on data_access while business is skipped.

cases.name: back-call
cases.description: A lower data_access layer depends on the higher business layer.

cases.name: cross-module
cases.description: A dependency crosses two explicitly configured modules.

cases.name: circular-dependency
cases.description: Two architecture components form a directed cycle.

cases.name: undeclared-edge
cases.description: Code contains an otherwise layer-valid dependency absent from the design graph.

cases.name: missing-edge
cases.description: The design declares a dependency not observed in CodeGraph.

cases.name: unmapped-node
cases.description: A source node has no unambiguous architecture mapping.

cases.name: combined-violations
cases.description: A project contains both a back-call and a cycle.

cases.name: ambiguous-mapping
cases.description: Two architecture candidates have equivalent names; automatic mapping must be withheld.
